_comment: REFERENCE ONLY — do not hand-merge this into settings.json. Run `python3 scripts/install_hooks.py`, which merges these entries beside whatever hooks you already have (Sentigent, gstack, formatters) instead of replacing the arrays, marks its own entries with _skill_router so re-running is idempotent, removes superseded hand-installed versions, and backs up settings.json first. Hand-merging is how this file drifted out of settings.json in the first place, which left routing silently inert for months.

_state_files.~/.claude/skill_usage.log: one line per Skill invocation; ground truth for the learning loop
_state_files.~/.claude/skill_router_pending.json: IRON RULE pending state, cleared each turn
_state_files.~/.claude/skill_router_strikes.json: silent-miss tallies, timestamped, expire after DEFER_TTL_DAYS
_state_files.~/.claude/skill_router_catalog.json: every invokable skill; rebuilt each SessionStart

hooks._purpose: Run the deterministic router and inject the [skill-router] announcement as context before the model's first action.
hooks.command: prompt=$(jq -r '.prompt // empty'); [ -z "$prompt" ] && exit 0; out=$(SKILL_ROUTER_HOOK_MODE=1 python3 /Users/airbook/.claude/skills/skill-router/scripts/router.py <<< "$prompt" 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$out" ] && exit 0; jq -n --arg msg "$out" '{systemMessage: $msg, hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "UserPromptSubmit", additionalContext: $msg}}'

hooks._purpose: IRON RULE: deny source-mutating tools until the announced skill has been invoked. Stands down inside sub-agents.
Record the invocation, drop it from pending state, and re-arm the skill by clearing its strike and override tallies.
IRON RULE final gate: block turn end if the announced skill was never invoked.
Tell each dispatched sub-agent which skills fit its job — the half of the work that previously ran skill-blind.
Refresh the skill catalog so newly installed skills are routable this session, and backfill plugin node_modules.
